name: free-planning-poker
author: Johannes Krumm
description: Estimate your story points faster and easier with this free agile scrum sprint planning poker app. Open source and privacy focused.

scripts.dev:all:nextjs: sleep 2 && bun run --filter=@fpp/web dev 2>&1 | logdy forward 7724
scripts.dev:all:server: sleep 2 && bun run --filter=@fpp/server dev 2>&1 | logdy forward 7725
scripts.dev:all:analytics: sleep 2 && ./scripts/kill-ports.sh 7722 && cd fpp-analytics && secrets-run run --env-file=.env.tpl -- uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 7722 2>&1 | logdy forward 7726
scripts.validate: concurrently --names "web,server,db,shared,analytics" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,blue,green,yellow" "bun run --filter=@fpp/web pre" "bun run --filter=@fpp/server validate" "bun run --filter=@fpp/db validate" "bun run --filter=@fpp/shared validate" "bun run fpp-analytics:validate"
scripts.fpp-analytics:format: cd fpp-analytics && uv run ruff format .
scripts.fpp-analytics:format:check: cd fpp-analytics && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.fpp-analytics:lint: cd fpp-analytics && uv run ruff check .
scripts.fpp-analytics:lint:fix: cd fpp-analytics && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.fpp-analytics:validate: bun run fpp-analytics:format && bun run fpp-analytics:lint && bun run fpp-analytics:type-check
